decisions.because: Assertion-red restore regression accepted a saved claim reason longer than the writer can emit. Replace whole-file allocation with a buffered streaming decoder, enforce token/record/collection budgets, retain rejected bytes and preserve failed restore status.

statement: State restore checks the writer-derived MAX_STATE_BYTES budget and JSON string/atom wire budgets while streaming, before unrestricted serde string allocation. Every retained input collection and string fits its named writer/runtime limit; nested support reasons are bounded too. Over-limit input is Failed, never Fresh, and original bytes are kept aside where possible. One extra bounded record may be decoded at a collection boundary. These bounds do not establish an RSS limit or a filesystem latency guarantee.
